_comment: slatewipe configuration. Everything here is a nuke-list, never a keep-list.
_id_comment: Reverse-DNS id for the app bundle, LaunchAgent labels and the Android app. Changing it after granting permissions means re-granting them.

quitApps._comment: GUI apps to quit on --go (graceful quit; an app that refuses, e.g. unsaved docs, is reported as untouched). --hard force-kills anything still running after the grace period. Cursor's open folders are read from its storage.json after it quits and recorded with an `open -a Cursor` resume line.

chrome._comment: Optional work/personal split. Windows in personalProfiles (Chrome profile names) are personal; any other profile is work. If personalProfiles is empty, every window is personal unless a tab URL matches workUrlPatterns. Only matters for routing to two archive targets (e.g. two Roam graphs).

terminals._comment: cwd under personalDirs → personal; under workDirs → work; anywhere else (Documents etc.) → personal.

server._comment: server.mjs (the phone button). The phone tries, in order: tunnel (https, Cloudflare Tunnel + Access service token), hosts (plain names, e.g. Tailscale MagicDNS or LAN hostname), Bonjour discovery on the LAN, the LAN IP baked in at build time.

roam._comment: Optional. Push each wipe to Roam's daily notes page. Set graph names here and tokens in mine/.env. Leave out a scope (or this whole section) to skip it.

finder._comment: Record Finder window paths and close them on --go.

sweep._comment: Move loose files into the archive dir on --go. Hidden files are skipped. Needs Files-and-Folders permission for SlateWiper (macOS asks on first run).

afterwards._comment: URLs to open in Chrome after a wipe (a 'begin again' page). Empty = open nothing.

autoSnapshot._comment: slate-watcher (LaunchAgent) runs `--snapshot` on these events. Edit and the watcher picks it up without restart.
